name: Okta — Authentication Brute Force From Single IP
xql_query:
dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter eventType contains "session.start" or eventType contains "authentication"
| alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
| filter outcome_result = "FAILURE" and ip != null and user_name != null
| filter not (ip contains "192.168." or ip contains "10." or ip contains "172.")
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count() as fails by ip, user_name, _time
| filter fails >= 5
| fields user_name, ip
description: ≥5 Okta authentication FAILURE events from one source IP within 30 minutes — credential spraying / brute force.
alert_name: Okta — Authentication Brute Force From Single IP
